{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue_clean'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)

# Filter out the 6 QA orders with revenue = 999999.99
df_filtered = df[df['revenue_clean'] != 999999.99]

# Filter for completed orders and loyal customers
loyal_completed = df_filtered[(df_filtered['customer_segment'] == 'loyal') & (df_filtered['status'] == 'completed')]

# Compute mean revenue
mean_revenue = loyal_completed['revenue_clean'].mean()

print(f"Number of loyal completed orders after filtering: {len(loyal_completed)}")
print(f"Mean revenue: {mean_revenue}")"}
